# Thirza Abernethy

## Overview

- **Age:** Middle-aged (sixty years old)  <sub>[v2 c8 P11](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0011)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c3 P0](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0000)</sub>
- **Role:** Housekeeper and caregiver  <sub>[v1 c8 P0](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0000)</sub>

## Appearance

Thirza is a stern-faced woman who occasionally wears a creaky, unaccustomed smile. She dresses in plain attire and manages the household chores around Grey Shutters.

_Sources: [v1 c3 P12](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0012), [v1 c3 P22](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0022), [v1 c8 P0](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0000)_

## Personality

Thirza is practical, authoritative, and strict, disliking pretense, unromantic notions, and crying or uncomposed emotions. She enforces obedience, order, and promptness, yet possesses an underlying sense of fairness and underlying compassion for children in her care.

_Sources: [v1 c3 P20](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0020), [v1 c8 P7](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0007), [v1 c8 P13](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0013), [v1 c8 P15](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0015), [v1 c9 P28](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0028), [v2 c17 P31](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0031)_

## Traits

- Practical and unsentimental  <sub>[v1 c3 P20](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0020), [v1 c8 P15](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0015)</sub>
- Strict disciplinarian  <sub>[v1 c8 P0](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0000), [v2 c17 P31](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0031)</sub>
- Fair-minded  <sub>[v1 c9 P26](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0026), [v1 c9 P28](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0028)</sub>

## Abilities

- Domestic housekeeping and meal preparation  <sub>[v1 c8 P0](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0000)</sub>

## Goals

- Raise Nell to be a dutiful, practical, and well-behaved young woman  <sub>[v1 c8 P5](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0005), [v1 c8 P7](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0007), [v1 c30 P42](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0042)</sub>

## History

Thirza lives at Grey Shutters alongside her brother Obed Abernethy. When Obed brought the young orphan Nell Harcourt home instead of an expected boy, Thirza initially expressed shock and concern over the mistake. However, after seeing Nell's distress and assessing her willingness to work, Thirza and Obed agreed to keep her. Despite Nell's intense temper outburst at Mrs. Agatha Sowerby, Thirza defended the young girl against excessive criticism while maintaining proper discipline. Over the following three years, Thirza raised Nell into a capable and reliable young woman, taking pride in her growth. She later helped manage the household with the arrival of the young twin children, Lucy and Robin Farrow, maintaining strict obedience and household order.

_Sources: [v1 c3 P0](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0000), [v1 c3 P4](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0004), [v1 c3 P13](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0013), [v1 c8 P0](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0000), [v1 c8 P5](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0005), [v1 c9 P26](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0026), [v1 c9 P28](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0028), [v1 c30 P41](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0041), [v1 c30 P42](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0042), [v2 c8 P11](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0011), [v2 c8 P16](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0016), [v2 c17 P31](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0031)_
